name: is-transfer-pricing
description: Prepare Iceland transfer-pricing workpapers for 2026 for resident legal entities and Icelandic permanent establishments. Identify related parties, distinguish arm's-length pricing from the preceding-year documentation threshold, support the selected method and reconcile controlled transactions. Covers annual documentation, RSK 4.28 disclosure, minor transactions, language, retention, request deadlines, documentation fines and a separate country-by-country reporting screen. Use for intercompany goods, services, loans, intangibles and branch dealings. Treaty-specific MAP relief is screened, not computed. General reference only; apply it to the client's documented facts.
